item.title: 3rd night running a carrier bag of rubbish has been thrown from a car onto my road - Sherwood Road, 19th August
item.description:
Being that our road is a cut through, when the rush hour starts you immediately know if there is litter in the road as you can constantly hear cars driving over it. As each of these 3 'dumps' have been carrier bags you initially hear them driving over the bag, and then the individual contents as it gets spread around! By the time we've got to it mid morning the contents have been strewn across and down the length of road and onto the neighbour's driveways. The whole of the road now needs cleaning, as do some driveways. In my mind the latest '3rd dump' is the worst. There is a dirty nappy on one driveway and presumably used wet wipes on another which I find disgusting and don't feel us residents should have to clear up! I know the rubbish extends at least as far as both the Falconwood Avenue and the Ashmore Grove crossroads, and is even in Ashmore Grove! Bag 1: Sainsburys carrier. Early hours of Saturday morning 15th August. General rubbish as well as a glass bottle or possibly a load of toughened glass, as it was all tiny square pieces. Unfortunately the Sainsburys carrier came to rest at mine and my neighbour's driveway so the glass ended up on the road outside both our properties, dropped kerbs and pavement outside both our houses! My husband cleared all this up thinking it was an isolated incident. Bag 2: Sainsburys carrier. Early hours of Monday morning 17th August. Lots of plastic recycling and drinks cans, and a couple of Cornetto wrappers and round cardboard disc lids. Several squashed ones still remain strewn along the length of road. Bag 3: 2.50am on Tuesday morning 18th August. There is a quantity of 6-8 dirty nappies strewn and squashed into the road, as well as a quantity of wet wipes and the offending carrier bag. I ticked it as witnessed in that I heard a thud outside on the street at 2.50am as a car drove past, this morning(Tuesday). Looked out and low and behold a 3rd carrier bag of household waste in 4 days! One neighbour may have cameras running and may therefore have caught a car driving past at that time. The road was quiet apart from this one car. I've selected no to hazardous - except that this 3rd 'drop' is DIRTY NAPPIES and WIPES!! so I am NOT picking them up! Afraid it's too dark for me to take a photograph. We'll see if there have been any more 'deposits' by the time I get up in the morning (Wed 19th).
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sherwood Road, Falconwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
